correctness.rationale: The intrinsic inball of an origin-symmetric cube section is constrained by projected coordinate strips, giving r^{-2}=1-a^2 for the smallest sorted normal coordinate. Rational enumeration reconstructs cube-edge intersections independently. The diameter is twice maximal vertex norm, with a rigorously compared two-regime free-coordinate formula. The spherical area element da dtheta is uniform in angle at fixed a, and analytic inversion of the strictly monotone branches gives the conditional distribution exactly. Endpoint extrema and the unique crossover follow from derivative signs, with the entire interval filled by continuity. Both embedded checkers passed; finite tests are not used as infinite proof.
